events.title: Small fixes on the demo
events.summary: A few fixes, and a little more room to see A small update to make things run a little smoother. FixesWorld map: Fixed the Back button in the settings bar. It now takes you back to the main menu as intended.Rewards: Fixed a rare save-and-load issue that could cause a pending reward to disappear. Your rewards are safe.Reroll: When no rerolls are available, the button now turns red. Clicking it also plays an error sound, making it clear that you're out of rerolls. ChangesFirst map, first run: Canno

events.title: Demo 0.11.4
events.summary: A small patch to add material cursor settings and some sound adjustments.

events.title: Demo v0.11.3 - New Features!
events.summary: New FeaturesBiome exploration: The outline that appears when hovering over a biome should now make it easier to understand where to explore next to continue discovering the biome.Biome labels: Biome labels now display their name, discovery percentage, as well as the events and ruins you have already found.Small animals: Small animals now bring a little more life to safe areas. They have no gameplay effect and will be scared of you!Recycle button: A Recycle button has been added to reward choices
